title: 续写任务的限制条件
goal: 依据原文和段首句判断续写情节是否符合已知条件。

points.label: 提取续写必须保留的原文事实
判断候选情节是否符合给定条件

sources.title: 高考英语（新课标卷）：课表
sources.used: 续写任务的限制条件与课程题目规格

body.p: 续写要接着原文往下写。人物关系、事件进行到哪一步、叙述视角，都不能改变。两个段首句还规定了每段从哪里写起。

body.box:
I waited beside my older sister at the closed gate. She held the key, but the lock would not turn.
Paragraph 1: My sister tried the key once more.
Paragraph 2: At last, the gate opened.

body.p: 叙述者和姐姐站在关着的门旁，钥匙在姐姐手里。第一段从姐姐再试一次开锁写起，第二段从门打开写起。

steps.d: 先记下人物之间的关系和各人手里的物品。I waited beside my older sister 说明叙述者和姐姐在一起。
分清哪些事已经发生、哪些还没有解决。The lock would not turn 说明锁还没打开。
两个段首句分别规定两段的起点。My sister tried the key once more 要求第一段接着写姐姐再试钥匙。
看候选情节有没有改变叙述视角和已知事实。后文可以写寻找锁打不开的原因，但要与两段的起点接上。

cards.title: 续写的限制条件
rows: 同行的人是叙述者的姐妹。
开始时钥匙在姐姐手中。
锁还没打开，后文可以交代原因。
用第一人称叙述，只写叙述者看到和知道的事。
My sister tried the key once more.
第一段从姐姐再次尝试开始。
第一段要为门打开做好铺垫。

body.box:
Nora borrowed her uncle's ladder to retrieve a ball from the shed roof. The ladder was too short.
Paragraph 1: Nora called her uncle for advice.
Paragraph 2: With his help, she reached the ball.

Which outline fits both openings?
1. Nora asks her uncle for a taller ladder; he brings one and helps her use it.
2. Nora finds the ball on the ground; her uncle keeps the ladder in the shed.
3. Nora gives her uncle a ball; he asks her to repair the shed roof.
4. Nora reaches the ball alone; her uncle later borrows her ladder.

body.p: 原文的困难是梯子太短。第一段首句要求 Nora 向叔叔求助，第二段首句要求她在叔叔帮助下拿到球。第一项保留了这个困难，又用叔叔送来更长的梯子把两段接上。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 原文写明人物是叔侄关系。
第一段首句写明她打电话求助。
Nora repaired the shed for her uncle.
丢开了取球的目标和梯子太短的困难。

groups.text: I lent my cousin a map. We were still outside the museum when rain began.

items.stem: Which fact must the continuation retain at this point?
options: My cousin had the map outside the museum.
My cousin had left the map inside the museum.
I had borrowed the map from my cousin.
I had entered the museum before the rain.
items.why: 依据是 I lent my cousin a map 和 We were still outside the museum。地图在表亲手里，两人还在馆外，即第一项。

groups.text:
Maya promised her brother to return his camera. She had left it in the library.
Paragraph 1: Maya went back to the library.

items.stem: Which outline follows the given facts?
options: Maya lends her camera to her brother at home.
Maya returns to the library to look for his camera.
Maya finds her brother's camera before leaving home.
Maya returns to the library to borrow a camera.
items.why: 依据是 She had left it in the library 和段首句的 went back to the library。Maya 回图书馆找那台相机，即第二项。第四项把找回相机改成了借相机。

groups.text:
I watched my neighbor carry a basket to the river. She had not crossed the bridge.
Paragraph 1: She stepped onto the bridge.

items.stem: Which outline keeps the narrator's viewpoint?
options: The neighbor secretly plans a route the narrator cannot know.
The neighbor tells the reader what she was thinking.
I see my neighbor test the bridge before crossing.
The neighbor narrates her own journey as I.
items.why: 依据是 I watched my neighbor。故事用第一人称，叙述者只能写自己看到的事。第三项写我看见邻居先试了试桥，保持了这个视角。

groups.text:
Eli and his grandfather planted seeds, but the soil had dried.
Paragraph 1: His grandfather brought a watering can.
Paragraph 2: Together they watered the seeds.

items.stem: Which outline connects the two openings?
options: His grandfather waters the seeds while Eli just watches.
Eli and his grandfather decide to leave the soil dry.
Eli plants seeds alone after the watering is complete.
Eli fills the can, and both of them water the dry soil.
items.why: 第一段祖父带来了水壶，第二段两人一起浇水。第四项写 Eli 把水壶装满、两人一起浇，两处就接上了。第一项只有祖父一人浇水。

groups.text:
I was helping my aunt prepare a picnic. The wind blew our list under a bench before we packed the food. My aunt reached for it, but it was caught beneath a box.
Paragraph 1: I moved the box carefully.
Paragraph 2: With the list in hand, we packed the food.

items.stem: What remains unresolved before the first opening?
options: The aunt has lost the food under the bench.
The list is still caught beneath the box.
The narrator has already packed the food.
The wind has blown the box under the bench.
items.why: 依据是 it was caught beneath a box，it 指清单。挪开箱子之前，清单一直被压着，即第二项。

options: I move the box; my aunt retrieves the list for packing.
I pack the food alone; my aunt throws the list away.
My aunt moves the bench; I write a new list at home.
I find the food under the box; my aunt leaves the picnic.
items.why: 第一段从我挪开箱子写起，第二段开始时清单已在手里。第一项写姑妈取回清单，两处就接上了。

groups.text:
I helped my brother repair a kite for our cousin. One wooden stick had snapped, and the kite could not fly. My brother had thread, but we needed another stick.
Paragraph 1: I went to the shed to look for one.
Paragraph 2: Our cousin held the repaired kite in the wind.

items.stem: Which fact is fixed before the first opening?
options: The cousin has already repaired the kite alone.
The narrator has found a replacement stick.
A broken stick prevents the kite from flying.
The brother has no thread for the repair.
items.why: 依据是 One wooden stick had snapped, and the kite could not fly。木条断了，风筝飞不起来，即第三项。

items.stem: Which outline best connects the openings?
options: I give away the thread and buy our cousin a new kite.
My brother takes the kite apart after our cousin flies it.
Our cousin breaks the stick after the kite is repaired.
I find a stick and my brother uses thread to attach it.
items.why: 第一段我去找木条，第二段风筝已经修好。第四项写找到木条，再用原文已有的 thread 绑上，两段就接上了。

items.stem: Complete the account of the first search.
items.why: I 是叙述者，found 用过去时；in the shed 是找到木条的地点。

items.stem: Complete a sentence about the repair.
items.why: 把新木条绑到风筝上，接着前面找木条的情节。

groups.text:
Lena and her father prepared a display of old family photographs. Lena had misplaced the photograph of her grandmother's garden. Her father remembered seeing it in a blue folder, which was still closed on the shelf.
Paragraph 1: Lena took the folder down.
Paragraph 2: The garden photograph was finally on the display board.

items.stem: Which detail must the first paragraph respect?
options: The folder is on the shelf and has not been opened.
The photograph is already fixed to the display board.
The father has already opened the blue folder.
The grandmother has misplaced Lena's garden display.
items.why: 依据是 which was still closed on the shelf。文件夹还在架子上，也没有打开，即第一项。

items.stem: Which outline leads naturally to the second opening?
options: Lena opens the folder but finds only empty pages.
Lena opens the folder and finds the missing photograph.
Her father removes the photograph from the finished board.
Her grandmother takes the empty folder to the garden.
items.why: 父亲记得照片在蓝色文件夹里。第二项打开文件夹找到照片，第二段照片才能上展示板。第一项打开了文件夹，却没有找到照片。

items.stem: Complete a sentence about the search.
items.why: Lena 已把文件夹从架上取下，接着打开它；opened 用过去时。

items.stem: Complete a sentence about the display.
items.why: placed the photograph on the board 与第二段照片已在展示板上的状态一致。
